candidates.change_summary: Delete the assert statement, allowing the deposit to proceed even if overflow would occur.
Replace the addition assignment with subtraction, so balances decrease on deposit.
Change the assertion to require(false), making all deposits revert.
Replace msg.sender with a fixed address in the balance update, so deposits always credit that address.
Insert a require statement that always reverts before any balance update.
Replace the require statement with a revert when amount equals balances[msg.sender]
Replace addition assignment with subtraction assignment, causing balance to increase instead of decrease
Swap the order of the transfer and the balance update, causing balance to be updated before transfer
Replace the transfer amount with a fixed value of 0, so no ether is sent
Replace `address(this).balance` with `0` so that migrateTo sends zero ether.
Replace `payable(to).transfer(...)` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(...)` so that funds go to the caller instead.
Delete the transfer statement entirely, so migrateTo does nothing.
